title: Interview Notice for the JPF and Semi-Skilled labour positions in the Department of Food Science & Technology

source.name: University of Kashmir, Jammu and Kashmir

text:
KEY LINES:
21.04.2026 (Tuesday) from 11:00 AM onwards in the

FULL TEXT:
Department of Food Science & Technology
(NAAC Accredited Grade – A++)
University of Kashmir, Hazratbal Srinagar-190 006.
Interview notice
Please be informed that the interview for the JPF and Semi-
Skilled labour positions under the JKSTIC sponsored research
project entitled "Utilization of polysaccharides and Chinar
leaves for designing of hydrogels as a sustainable irrigation
system for high-density apple orchard
plants..." , implemented by the Department of Food Science
and Technology, University of Kashmir,will be held on
21.04.2026 (Tuesday) from 11:00 AM onwards in the
Department of Food Science & Technology.
Applicants are required to bring all relevant documents in
original and as photocopies.
Sd/-
Dr. Adil Gani
Principal Investigator
